title: IT helpdesk deflection page, no code, on Lovable
description: Prompt Lovable into a private, single-user IT helpdesk prototype on the Glean Chat API, with zero hand-written backend.

questions.prompt: What is your work email? It is used once to discover your Glean tenant.
What IT topic should the first suggested question cover? Pick something you know exists in your Glean content.

prerequisites: A Glean Client API token with the CHAT scope. Create it in Admin Console → API access → Client API tokens, then keep it as a Lovable backend secret; every request uses this one token owner's access
A private Lovable project. Multi-user deployments require authenticated per-user Glean OAuth

demoQueries.query: Where do I reset my SSO password?
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: Returns a non-empty answer with at least one citation carrying a real title and URL, drawn from your own indexed content.

demoQueries.query: How do I request a new laptop?
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: Returns a non-empty answer with at least one citation carrying a real title and URL, drawn from your own indexed content.

codeAssets.description: The exact Lovable prompt + secrets checklist

steps.title: Resolve your Glean instance
steps.description: Copy the instance slug from your Glean URL, the part in https://<instance>-be.glean.com. That slug is GLEAN_INSTANCE. Plugin users run the command instead and take the same slug from the returned URL.

steps.title: Fill the prompt template
steps.description: Open recipes/no-code-it-helpdesk-lovable/lovable-prompt.md. Replace <your-glean-instance> with the instance slug, and set the first suggested question to a natural question about the supplied topic. Plugin users show the filled prompt and stop. Do not open Lovable.

steps.title: Paste into a new private Lovable project
steps.description: Start a new private project at https://lovable.dev and paste the filled prompt as the first message. Plugin users hand the filled prompt to the user. Do not open Lovable.

steps.title: Add secrets when Lovable asks
steps.description: When Lovable asks, add GLEAN_API_TOKEN and GLEAN_INSTANCE as backend secrets, never in the chat. The token is one service identity. Keep the project private.

steps.title: Verify with two live questions
steps.description: Ask "Where do I reset my SSO password?" and "How do I request a new laptop?" Each should return a cited answer from your own indexed content.

aiPrompt: I'm using Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex, not Lovable. Do not open Lovable. Ask for my work email if needed, run `node <cookbook-plugin-root>/scripts/resolve-backend.mjs "<work-email>"`, and take the instance slug from the returned https://<instance>-be.glean.com URL. Open recipes/no-code-it-helpdesk-lovable/lovable-prompt.md. Replace <your-glean-instance> with that slug and set the first suggested question to a natural question about the supplied topic. Show me the filled prompt so I can paste it into a new private Lovable project. Remind me GLEAN_API_TOKEN and GLEAN_INSTANCE go in Lovable backend secrets, never in the prompt. Then walk the remaining steps.
llmContext: Keep this single-user prototype private. Its shared backend token is one service identity, so every request has the token owner's access. Multi-user deployment requires app authentication and per-user Glean OAuth. Keep the token in Lovable's server-side secret store, call Client Chat from a backend function, and read CONTENT text and fragment.citation.sourceDocument citations. GLEAN_INSTANCE is the instance slug from https://<instance>-be.glean.com.

content.problem: Half your helpdesk tickets are "how do I reset my SSO password" and "how do I get a new laptop." Your IT docs already answer both. You want a page that answers them before a ticket gets filed, without pulling an engineer off other work to build it.
takeItFurther: Scope the `CHAT` token even further if your Glean plan supports per-collection tokens, so this tool can only ever answer from IT content.
Compare this to [`no-code-pto-lookup-replit`](/cookbook/no-code-pto-lookup-replit). Same Chat API call, same constraint that the browser never holds the token, different no-code tool and persona.
Once your team outgrows the no-code version, [`company-answers`](/cookbook/company-answers) shows the same pattern as a hand-written, version-controlled app.

limitations.title: Not tested on a live Lovable account
limitations.description: This walkthrough has not been run end-to-end against a live Lovable account. Confirm the two verify questions on your own instance before you rely on the generated app.
